title: Update release team membership for osqp_vendor (tier4 or moveit)
author: christian-rauch
body:
# Updates to tier4 membership.

The [`osqp_vendor` repo](https://github.com/tier4/osqp_vendor) appears abandoned and specifically the PR https://github.com/tier4/osqp_vendor/pull/25, which unblocks MoveIt2 builds, is unmerged for 3.5 months now.

I request to either have myself added to the `tier4.tf` release team, in order to release new `osqp_vendor` packages, or alternatively, I request that the `osqp_vendor-release` repo is moved from the `tier4.tf` to the `moveit.tf` release team and that I am added to the `moveit.tf` release team.

## New team members

* [@christian-rauch](LINK TO SOURCE PACKAGE.XML MAINTAINER/AUTHOR TAG)
